doc: # useClipboard ## Overview `useClipboard` copies text to the clipboard through the Clipboard API, falling back to the copy command where that's missing or refused, and keeps a `copied` flag for a moment after a copy. It's what [`CopyButton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/copybutton) is built on. Use it for a trigger of your own: a link, a code block that copies when clicked, or a menu item. It announces nothing, so a trigger of your own says "Copied" itself, as the examples below do. For a button, `CopyButton` does all of that already. --- ## Import ```tsx import { useClipboard } from '@allxsmith/bestax-bulma'; ``` --- ## Usage ### A Trigger of Your Own Call `copy` from the click with the text, and read `copied` for the moment after. The status region is in the page from the start, empty, and says "Copied" while `copied` is `true`, since a screen reader reliably announces a live region whose text changes and not always one that appears with its text. The button's name, "Copy commit 4a1986a", holds the words on it. ```tsx live function CommitId() { const sha = '4a1986aa2c7f3e1b9d05e6a8f2c4b7d1e3f5a9c8'; const short = sha.slice(0, 7); const { copy, copied } = useClipboard({ duration: 1500 }); return ( <> copy(sha)} > {short} {copied ? `Copied commit ${short}` : ''} {copied ? 'Copied' : ''} ); } ``` ### Handling a Failure When nothing could write, `copy` resolves `false` and `error` holds the reason. Say so, and give the reader a way to copy the text themselves. The status line below reports either outcome, since a screen reader doesn't always announce a focused button's new label. ```tsx live function InviteCode() { const code = 'BESTAX-2026'; const { copy, copied, error } = useClipboard(); return ( <> {copied && 'Invite code copied.'} {error && `Couldn't copy it, so copy ${code} by hand.`} ); } ``` ### Text You Have to Fetch Browsers allow a write only shortly after a click or a key press, and in Firefox and Safari a fetch that takes a few seconds can outlast that. Fetch the text before the click where you can, and call `copy` as soon as you have it where you can't. A copy that has run out of time fails like any other. ```tsx const { copy } = useClipboard(); async function copyShareLink() { const { url } = await fetch('/api/share-link').then(r => r.json()); if (!(await copy(url))) showTheLink(url); } ``` --- ## How It Writes `copy` calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText`. Where `navigator.clipboard` is missing, as it is on any page served over plain `http://` other than `localhost`, or where `writeText` refuses, as Chromium does in a cross-origin frame without `allow="clipboard-write"`, it falls back to `document.execCommand('copy')` with a `copy` listener that puts the text on the clipboard. Where `navigator.clipboard` is missing, that runs straight away, before `copy` awaits anything, so it's still inside the click. The fallback counts as a success only if the `copy` event fired, since WebKit's `execCommand` returns `false` from a copy that happened. `execCommand` is deprecated, and the hook keeps the call in one function, so it can go when the browsers drop it. It writes plain text only, and never reads the clipboard. --- ## API ```ts function useClipboard(options?: UseClipboardOptions): UseClipboardResult; interface UseClipboardOptions { duration?: number; onCopiedChange?: (copied: boolean) => void; onCopyError?: (error: Error) => void; } interface UseClipboardResult { copy: (text: string) => Promise; copied: boolean; error: Error | null; } ``` ### Options | Option | Type | Default | Description | | ------------------------ | --------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `options.duration` | `number` | `2000` | How long `copied` stays `true` after a copy, in milliseconds. Another copy restarts it. | | `options.onCopiedChange` | `(copied: boolean) => void` | — | Called with `true` after each copy that worked, a repeat included, and with `false` when `duration` runs out or a later copy fails. | | `options.onCopyError` | `(error: Error) => void` | — | Called when neither the Clipboard API nor the copy command could write, with the Clipboard API's own error when it refused (such as a `NotAllowedError`), or an `Error` saying neither could. | The callbacks are read when they fire, so an inline function is fine. ### Returns | Value | Type | Description | | -------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `copy` | `(text: string) => Promise` | Writes `text`, and resolves `true` once it's written or `false` when it couldn't be. It never rejects, and it keeps its identity from render to render. | | `copied` | `boolean` | `true` for `duration` after a copy that worked. | | `error` | `Error \| null` | Why the last copy failed, or `null` after one that worked. A failed copy also ends `copied`, so the two are never set together. | On the server it does nothing: `copied` is `false`, `error` is `null`, and nothing reads the clipboard or the page while rendering. Once the component calling it has unmounted, nothing changes and no callback fires. The timer that ends `copied` is cleared, and a write already under way finishes without reporting back, though `copy`'s promise still resolves. --- ## Accessibility - Announce the result. A "Copied" message is a status message ([WCAG 4.1.3](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html)): put it in a `role="status"` region that's in the page, empty, before the click, and write into it after. - Don't count on a changed label alone. A change to a focused button's text isn't read out by every screen reader and browser pairing. - Keep the trigger's name holding the words on it, so a voice control user can say what they see. - When a copy fails, say so, and leave the text where the reader can select and copy it. --- ## Related Components - [`CopyButton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/copybutton): A button built on this hook, with the label, the icon and the announcement. - [`LinkButton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/linkbutton): A button that looks like a link, for a trigger in running text. --- ## Additional Resources - [Storybook: useClipboard Stories](https://bestax.io/storybook/?path=/story/helpers-useclipboard--default) - [MDN: Clipboard API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Clipboard_API) - [MDN: document.execCommand()](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/execCommand)
